President Donald Trump said he had just been briefed on the incident, describing it as “not good”. FRANCE 24’s Fraser Jackson reports from Washington DC.

title: Man convicted of starting palisades fire

title: Anthropic mathematician claims he used Claude to prove 19th-century Riemann hypothesis
summary: Levent Alpöge says it took six weeks for him using the AI tool to solve the math problem involving prime numbers A mathematician at Anthropic is contending that the San Francisco -based artificial intelligence (AI) company’s software has helped crack one of the most important unsolved problems in mathematics. Levent Alpöge, a Turkish American mathematician, on Friday posted a note on his personal website saying that Claude, the AI software, had helped prove the Riemann hypothesis. He says that Claude helped develop a solution to the problem during the course of about six weeks. Continue reading...

Despite an overwhelming majority of states at the UN’s Convention on Certain Conventional Weapons (CCW) in Geneva wanting to agree a negotiating mandate leading to a legally binding treaty, the need for consensus forced the conference to adopt a much weaker option. Continue reading...

title: France: Demonstrations losing steam as movement enters sixth week
summary: Around 2,200 people took part in protests across France by 2pm local time, according to the Interior Ministry, which recorded 44 demonstrations nationwide and seven arrests, with the situation described as generally calm. Turnout was lower than on previous Saturdays. Reporting from Place de la République in Paris, FRANCE 24’s Antonia Kerrigan said rent rights organisations had also joined the sixth consecutive Saturday of protests, highlighting their growing pan-European dimension, with demonstrations taking place in seven European countries, including Spain, Portugal, Greece and Germany, where rising living costs and access to affordable housing are among the main concerns.

title: Macron to inaugurate Cambodia temple after 14-year restoration
summary: In Cambodia, French President Emmanuel Macron and King Norodom Sihamoni are expected to inaugurate a newly restored temple at the world-famous Angkor archaeological site on Monday. After 14 years of painstaking work, the Western Mebon, a thousand-year-old monument, has been restored to its former glory. A monumental restoration effort, bringing together Cambodian and French expertise. Alix Ostian, Aruna Popuri and Constantin Simon report.

title: Canary Islands struggle to cope after massive influx of migrants
summary: Nearly 2,200 migrants have reached Spain’s Canary Islands by boat over the past two days, Spain’s maritime rescue service said on Sunday. title: עורך הדין החשוד בניסיון להבריח סמים לעצור בכלא שטה יישאר במעצר 4 ימים
summary: עורך הדין אשרף חג’אזי הוא החשוד בניסיון הברחת סמים לאסיר בבית הסוהר שטה, כך נחשף היום (שני) בדיון בהארכת מעצרו בבית משפט השלום בטבריה. חג’אזי נעצר אתמול לאחר שבמהלך בידוק ביטחוני בכניסה לבית הסוהר התגלה בכיס מעילו חומר החשוד כסם, בכמות שאינה לצריכה עצמית. המשטרה ביקשה להאריך את מעצרו בשבעה ימים, אולם בתום הדיון ובהסכמת הצדדים הוארך מעצרו עד יום חמישי הקרוב.
